steps.expected_state: cop busi utuh dipegang dekat busi, tidak pecah dan kabel tersambung

steps.instruction: Putar kontak ke ON dan tekan starter untuk menghidupkan mesin. Dengarkan suara mesin hidup langsam.

steps.expected_state: motor menyala langsam dan cop busi tetap menancap tidak lepas kena getaran

steps.voice_text: Coba starter motor, pastikan mesin mau hidup dan tidak lepas lagi.

steps.instruction: Putar kontak ke OFF, cabut kunci, dan tegakkan motor di standar tengah. Jika mesin hangat, tunggu 15 menit sampai dingin disentuh.
steps.why: Mesin dingin dan kontak mati mencegah luka bakar dan motor hidup tiba-tiba.
steps.expected_state: Kunci kontak OFF dan tercabut, motor tegak di standar tengah, mesin dingin saat disentuh.
warnings: Mesin panas bisa membakar tangan
steps.voice_text: Matikan kontak, cabut kunci, tunggu mesin sampai dingin dulu ya.

steps.instruction: Tarik cop busi lurus ke atas sampai lepas dari busi. Jangan tarik bagian kabelnya.
steps.why: Cop harus dilepas dulu agar busi bisa dibuka dan dibersihkan.
steps.expected_state: Cop busi tergantung lepas, ujung keramik busi terlihat jelas dan terbuka.
warnings: Jangan pegang cop busi saat menekan starter karena bisa menyetrum
steps.voice_text: Tarik cop busi lurus ke atas perlahan, jangan tarik kabelnya ya.

steps.instruction: Pasang kunci busi 16mm ke busi dan putar ke kiri sampai lepas. Angkat busi keluar dengan tangan.
steps.why: Busi harus dikeluarkan untuk melihat kotoran atau kerusakan penyebab api hilang.
steps.expected_state: Busi sudah keluar dari kepala silinder, lubang busi terlihat kosong.
steps.voice_text: Putar kunci busi ke kiri perlahan sampai busi terlepas.

steps.instruction: Sikat ujung busi dan lap sampai bersih dan kering. Periksa besi ujung tidak patah dan keramik tidak retak.
steps.why: Kerak hitam dan basah membuat api kecil sehingga motor susah hidup.
steps.expected_state: Ujung busi terlihat bersih kering, elektroda utuh dan keramik tidak retak.
warnings: Jauhkan bensin dan api saat membersihkan busi
steps.voice_text: Bersihkan ujung busi sampai kering dan periksa tidak retak ya.

steps.instruction: Putar busi masuk dengan tangan ke kanan sampai kencang. Kencangkan sedikit saja dengan kunci, jangan terlalu keras.
steps.why: Busi yang pasangannya pas dan rapat membuat kompresi dan api normal kembali.
steps.expected_state: Busi terpasang tegak dan rapat di kepala silinder, tidak miring dan tidak longgar.
steps.voice_text: Pasang busi pakai tangan dulu, lalu kencangkan sedikit dengan kunci.

steps.instruction: Tekan cop busi ke ujung busi sampai masuk penuh dan terasa klik. Coba starter motor untuk menghidupkan mesin.
steps.why: Cop yang menancap penuh memastikan api dari koil sampai ke busi.
steps.expected_state: Cop busi menancap penuh ke busi tanpa celah, motor bisa dicoba starter.
warnings: Jangan pegang cop busi saat menekan starter karena bisa menyetrum
steps.voice_text: Tekan cop busi sampai klik penuh, lalu coba starter motornya.

plan.done_check: Motor distarter langsung hidup dan langsam stabil tanpa mati lagi.
plan.when_to_call_pro: Hubungi bengkel jika busi basah oli, keramik pecah, elektroda habis, atau motor tetap tidak hidup setelah dibersihkan.

handoff.title: Hand it to a mechanic
handoff.text:
Hi, I need help from a repair shop.
Item: Honda Beat scooter engine cylinder head and spark plug area
Problem: Honda Beat cranks but does not fire. Photo shows spark plug cap completely off the spark plug, so engine is getting no spark.
Likely causes: Disconnected spark plug cap - no spark reaching plug (88%); Fouled or worn spark plug (55%); Aged ignition wiring / plug cap connection fault (35%)
Already tried: Disconnected spark plug cap - no spark reaching plug
Steps checked by camera: 0/5
Guide & photos: http://testserver/guide/replay-motor-en
PDF report (with a mechanic brief): http://testserver/api/sessions/replay-motor-en/report.pdf
Sent from Tukang Copilot

look.note: Honda Beat scooter engine cylinder head and spark plug area

diagnose.note: Disconnected spark plug cap - no spark reaching plug

steps.instruction: Turn key OFF, remove key and put scooter on center stand. Let engine cool until cylinder head feels cool.
steps.why: A cool dead engine prevents burns and accidental spark near fuel.
steps.expected_state: key out, scooter on center stand, cylinder head cool to touch
warnings: Hot engine parts can burn skin
Petrol vapour can catch fire - no smoking or flames
steps.voice_text: Key off now. Let the engine cool completely before you touch the plug.

steps.instruction: Pull spark plug cap straight off the plug. Wipe dust around the plug with dry cloth.
steps.why: Clear access lets you remove the plug without dirt falling into the engine.
steps.expected_state: spark plug cap pulled away from plug, dust wiped away, spark plug clearly visible
warnings: Do not touch plug area if engine is still hot
steps.voice_text: Pull the cap off gently. Wipe the dust away so nothing falls inside.

steps.instruction: Fit 16mm plug wrench over spark plug and turn left to unscrew. Lift plug straight out.
steps.why: Removing the plug lets you see fouling or wear that stops spark.
steps.expected_state: spark plug unscrewed and out, empty plug hole in cylinder head visible
warnings: Plug ceramic can crack and cut if forced
steps.voice_text: Fit the wrench on. Turn left slowly and lift the plug out.

steps.instruction: Brush plug tip clean and wipe dry. If tip is black, wet, oily, cracked or worn, use new plug instead.
steps.why: A clean intact plug can spark, while a fouled or worn tip cannot.
steps.expected_state: spark plug tip clean and dry with intact electrode, or new NGK CPR7EA-9 plug ready
warnings: Do not use a cracked or broken plug
steps.voice_text: Check the tip. Clean it, or swap in a new plug if black or damaged.

steps.instruction: Screw plug in by hand to the right until finger-tight. Snug only 1/4 turn with wrench.
steps.why: Correct seating seals compression and puts the tip where spark works.
steps.expected_state: spark plug seated flush straight in cylinder head, no tilt or gap at base
warnings: Cross-threading damages engine - stop if it feels tight early
steps.voice_text: Screw it in by hand first. Then snug it just a quarter turn.

steps.instruction: Push spark plug cap firmly onto plug until it clicks. Try starting the engine.
steps.why: A tight cap delivers spark from coil to the clean plug to fire the engine.
steps.expected_state: spark plug cap pushed fully onto spark plug, no gap, firmly connected
warnings: Keep hands, clothes away from moving parts and hot exhaust when starting
steps.voice_text: Push the cap on hard till it clicks. Now try to start it.

plan.done_check: Engine cranks and fires up quickly and idles steadily without stalling.
plan.when_to_call_pro: Call a mechanic if new plug still gives no start, threads are damaged, plug gets wet with fuel or oil, or you see fuel leaks.
